question: Who was the flag bearer for India for the opening ceremony of the Asian Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Neeraj Chopra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra is an Indian track and field athlete who competes in the javelin throw.**
 
• He was born on **December 24, 1997, in Khandra village, Panipat district, Haryana.**
 
• Chopra won a gold medal in the** javelin throw event at the 2018 Commonwealth Games with a throw of 86.47 meters.**
 
• He was also the flag bearer for India at the **opening ceremony of the 2018 Asian Games, which were held in Jakarta and Palembang, Indonesia**.

About Asian Games 2018

 
• **Asian Games 2018 was hosted in Jakarta, Indonesia.**
 
• India competed at the 2018 Asian Games in Jakarta and Palembang, Indonesia, from 18th August to 2nd September.
 
• **Rani Rampal was named as the flag bearer for the closing ceremony.**
 
• **India ranked 8th in the 2018 Asian Games Medal Table with 69 medals in total.**
 
• **China topped** the medal tally with 132 Golds and a total of 289 Medals.
 
• Japanese swimmer Ikee Rikako was named the Most Valuable Player (MVP) of the recently concluded 18th edition of the Asian Games.

• Rani Rampal is an Indian field hockey player who was named the captain of the Indian women's hockey team in 2018.
 
• She was born on December 4, 1994, in Shahbad Markanda, Haryana.
 
• Rampal has won several awards and accolades, including the Arjuna Award in 2016 and the Padma Shri in 2020.
 
• She has represented India at numerous international tournaments, including the Olympics and the World Cup.

**Sanjeev Rajput:**

 
• Sanjeev Rajput is an Indian shooter who competes in the 10-meter air rifle and 50-meter rifle 3 positions events.
 
• He was born on January 5, 1981, in Yamunanagar, Haryana.
 
• Rajput has won several medals at international shooting events, including the Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games.
 
• He was awarded the Arjuna Award in 2011 for his achievements in the field of shooting.

** Deepak Kumar:**

 
• Deepak Kumar is an Indian shooter who competes in the 10-meter air rifle and 50-meter rifle 3 positions events.
 
• He was born on January 28, 1987, in Hathras, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Kumar won a silver medal in the 10-meter air rifle event at the 2018 Asian Games.
 
• He has also won several medals at international shooting events, including the Commonwealth Games and the World Cup.
